spec.description:
BigtableMemoryLayerSpec defines the desired state of BigtableMemoryLayer.

A memory layer serves reads from memory without hitting the backing
persistent data store. It is a singleton of its cluster: the existence of a
BigtableMemoryLayer object enables the memory layer on the referenced
cluster, and deleting the object disables it.

clusterRef.description: Immutable. The BigtableCluster whose memory layer this resource manages.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed BigtableCluster resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/clusters/{{clusterID}}".

name.description: The name of a BigtableCluster resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BigtableCluster resource.
